connector.name: Goldhold
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory for AI agents. Search, store, and recall across sessions.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.goldhold.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jerrysrodz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: your GoldHold API key from goldhold.ai/account
